title: Cubic atomic support and exact neighbour balance
statement: Three-space supplies three axes and the binary Fold supplies the two held directions on each axis, forcing six nearest neighbours.  Dividing the half-One balance equally over those complete neighbours forces weight one-twelfth per neighbour and their exact sum is the half-One.
generation_rule: Generate the complete eight-axis cubic-support product.
grammar_boundary: All nearest-neighbour organizations using every held direction on every forced spatial axis and an exact equal partition of the half-One balance.

axes.question: What carries the cubic atomic support?

choices.name: untyped-observed-label
choices.reason: A label alone is not a generated law.

choices.name: generated-exact-Fold-carrier
choices.reason: The carrier is constructed from admitted exact Fold counts and relations.

choices.name: selected-partial-support
choices.reason: A selected subset can tune the result.

choices.name: complete-typed-support
choices.reason: Every support cell named by the law is generated and retained.

choices.name: imported-continuum-operation
choices.reason: An imported continuum operation violates the exact domain.

choices.name: exact-positive-Fold-operation
choices.reason: Only exact positive composition, ratio and guarded Take occur.

choices.name: signed-or-erased-direction
choices.reason: Signed proof values or erased direction violate the domain.

choices.name: held-label-orientation
choices.reason: Direction is represented by retained labels and ordered positive Take.

choices.name: selected-depth
choices.reason: A chosen depth is a parameter.

choices.name: forced-counted-depth
choices.reason: The binary, generator-three and already admitted covering counts force the depth.

axes.question: May measured atomic data enter the law?

choices.name: measurement-readable-relation
choices.reason: A measured target cannot construct or select the survivor.

choices.name: target-inaccessible-formal-relation
choices.reason: The formal module contains no measured energy or wavelength.

choices.name: result-without-dependency-trace
choices.reason: An untraced result cannot be admitted.

choices.name: complete-root-directed-trace
choices.reason: The result retains its dependency chain to the foundational theorem.

axes.question: May an extra term or rule be appended?

choices.name: free-extra-rule
choices.reason: An extra rule introduces a choice.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: The declared typed grammar is exhausted.

exact_result: The unique cubic support has 2*3=6 nearest neighbours, exact weight 1/12 per neighbour and complete balance 6/12=1/2.
induction_base: One spatial axis has exactly the two held Fold directions.
induction_step: Appending each of the remaining forced axes contributes the same two directions once; equal partition of the half-One over the completed six-cell support fixes one-twelfth.
exclusions: no floating or signed proof value

witnesses.name: coordination
witnesses.statement: Binary directions on three axes force six neighbours.

witnesses.name: half-balance
witnesses.statement: All six neighbour weights recompose the half-One.
